capabilities: Format the current file via right-click context menu or command palette
Batch-format all .md files in a folder
Customize formatting rules through an editable YAML template
Normalize headings, lists, code blocks, tables, quotes, horizontal rules, and paragraph spacing
Insert automatic spacing between CJK and Latin text
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Front Matter is left untouched by formatting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-click tool to normalize Markdown layout (spacing, indentation, alignment) across a file or a whole folder.
summary: Rule-based Markdown formatter that beautifies note layout with customizable YAML rules, without changing text content.
